gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Noto Sans Ol Chiki keeps its curve tails pulled back, so words land as solid blocks. Coming Soon is the loose, pen-drawn counterpart, with a ring-shaped o and a steady, technical-pen line that makes a plain sans body feel even more orderly over a long stretch of text.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-old-hung: Coming Soon scribbles out casual, pen-and-paper letters with no stroke modulation at all, and its lowercase climbs near the capitals. Noto Sans Old Hungarian handles the sturdy, open-shaped reading.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-old-ital: Hand-lettered but ruler-straight. Coming Soon draws a constant-width line with casual charm, while Noto Sans Old Italic sits close to cap height, its curve endings kept well apart, and handles the steady reading.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-old-nort: Wire-like and casual, Coming Soon looks drawn in one thin, even line with a ring of an o. And Noto Sans Old North Arabian takes over for reading, packing a dense, tall lowercase band with terminals pointing outward.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-old-perm: Casual and personal, Coming Soon writes like pen on paper, its round letters showing no tilted stress. Noto Sans Old Permic backs it with rounded forms open to the side and a lowercase nearly matching the capitals, so the plain sans text feels friendly beside the handwriting.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-old-pers: Contemporary in feel, yet Coming Soon is all casual hand: every curve as thick as a straight stem, like a drawn line. And Noto Sans Old Persian does the quiet work, with open counters breathing into the white space.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-old-sogd: Loose pen strokes meet crisp, wide-mouthed text. Coming Soon bends its s like wire that never thins at the spine, and Noto Sans Old Sogdian's tall x-height, nearly reaching cap height, gives the pair its best quality: a friendly handwritten voice that stays sharp.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-old-turk: Coming Soon draws the same line width through its curves and straights, like a casual hand with one pen. Noto Sans Old Turkic is the plain sans, chunky and open-mouthed for reading.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Noto Sans Oriya has generous gaps in its curves and small letters nearly as tall as the capitals. And Coming Soon sits beside it with a gentle monotone line, casual and personal, a handwritten partner to the plain sans.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-osage: Noto Sans Osage reads inflated and sweeping, its bowls filling the line. Coming Soon adds a bent-paperclip scrawl with no swelling, and beside the plain sans body it feels casual, personal and pleasantly uncluttered.
